inputs.declared_question: Does the proposed Community Notes adjacency remain supported by current primary sources, and can its public catalog evidence be followed to literal proposal records?

internal_region.title: Expeditions, Storms, and the Birth of Boroughs

sources_checked.title: Cyberdelic OS Living Field Notes exact source

source_facts.claim: The current introduction says Community Notes does not work by majority rule and displays notes only after contributors who have sometimes disagreed in prior ratings find them helpful.
The diversity documentation says perspective is inferred from prior note-rating patterns rather than demographics, political affiliation, follows, or posts.
The current ranking documentation continues to use matrix factorization to identify broad appeal across viewpoints and assigns each note one global score rather than personalizing results.
Field Note 14 explicitly names Community Notes as an open reference for ranking contributions that achieve helpfulness across differing perspectives.
source_facts.locator: Community Notes provides a real, open reference for ranking contributions that achieve helpfulness across differing perspectives.

cartographer.inference: The existing Community Notes proposals remain useful references for cross-perspective helpfulness and for resisting raw majority rule. They remain narrower than the multi-perspective, provenance-rich, dissent-preserving artifacts imagined by Cyberdelic OS.
cartographer.uncertainty: The relationships remain model-proposed. Inferred rating perspectives cannot represent every form of difference, and a global helpfulness status does not establish truth, consensus, endorsement, or a complete deliberative record.
cartographer.attribution: External facts come from the official Community Notes guide, its source Markdown, and its public repository. Internal facts come from the exact public Field Notes source.
cartographer.no_proposal_reason: The bounded source recheck continued to support the existing node and two edge proposals. A new candidate would duplicate the current proposal queue.

decisions.decision: Keep the existing internal evidence because the cited Field Note headings and the exact Community Notes sentence remain present in the source and continue to support the proposal claims.
Leave descriptions, relation types, epistemic statuses, lifecycles, inferences, and unresolved questions unchanged because current primary sources still support their cautious boundaries.
Leave the three-item Attending arrangement unchanged and do not create a dated tending page because no node, edge, rationale, lifecycle state, or related-work path changed.

evidence.locator: Community Notes provides a real, open reference for ranking contributions that achieve helpfulness across differing perspectives.

gardener.decision_reason: The current proposal evidence and qualifications remain accurate. No relational metadata change is warranted.

decisions.decision: Replace the synthetic proposal range with the three literal proposal identifiers present in the cited queue.
Leave the summary, subjects, search terms, questions, relations, and proposal state unchanged because current primary and exact internal sources support them.
Keep directory results bounded to six and the default Library aperture at three works.

librarian.decision_reason: The record remained findable, but its evidence locator described a range rather than quoting text present in the proposal queue. Literal identifiers restore auditability without expanding the catalog.

checks.result: Current official Community Notes documentation, source Markdown, and repository remain consistent with the existing proposed node, two adjacencies, and explicit limits.

All 2,871 local links and assets resolved across 138 HTML pages.

A homepage search for different viewpoints returned the tended Community Notes neighbour as one result, within the six-result limit. The three-work default Library aperture remained unchanged.

unresolved_questions: Which kinds of disagreement remain invisible when perspective is inferred only from rating patterns?
What evidence, testimony, provenance, and dissent must remain visible beyond one global helpfulness status?
